responsibility: Implements 32-bit SPARC ABI lowering for FnAbi, tracking cumulative argument offsets so aggregate arguments are coerced into i32 register chunks with alignment padding and aggregate returns use an indirect result pointer.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/sparc.rs`, this file is the 32-bit SPARC function ABI classifier, tracking offsets and padding for aggregate arguments and indirect aggregate returns instead of exposing inline-assembly registers.
